full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white fashion photograph shows a short-haired young person seated against a plain gray wall with a large dark diagonal shadow behind them. The sitter is placed slightly left of center, shown from the upper thighs upward. They wear a simple black sleeveless top, loose mid-gray trousers, and a thin necklace with a small pendant. The left shoulder and arm are fully exposed; the right arm descends toward the lap. Both hands rest low near the knees, partly hidden by the dark foreground and the folds of the trousers. The posture is relaxed but self-contained, with the torso upright and the head turned slightly to the left. Short dark hair is cut close around the ears and tousled on top. Light falls from the upper left, making the near arm and side of the face pale while the far half of the face enters a hard shadow. The expression is reserved, with lips closed and gaze directed off-frame left. The gray wall behind has faint fabriclike or plaster texture. A large triangular black shadow sweeps from behind the sitter's head toward the right and lower edge, shaping the composition almost as strongly as the figure. Another deep dark wedge enters the bottom left foreground. The trousers provide a softer middle-gray plane across the lower right, their broad folds catching muted light. Photographic grain is fine and visible, and the tonal scale ranges from near-white skin highlights through textured gray to dense matte black. The background contains no recognizable objects or text, only surface and shadow. The arrangement uses the pale exposed arms, compact dark top, and severe diagonal wall shape to create an austere, slightly confrontational stillness, with the off-center figure firmly grounded by shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形黑白时尚照片描绘一名短发年轻人坐在素灰墙前，身后有一大块深暗斜影。坐者位于中心稍左，从大腿上部以上入画。身穿简单黑色无袖上衣、宽松中灰裤，戴细项链和小坠饰。左肩与手臂完全露出；右臂落向膝上。双手低放在膝旁，部分被深暗前景与裤褶遮住。姿态放松却自我收拢，躯干挺直，头略向左转。短黑发贴着耳朵修剪，顶部略乱。光从左上落下，使近处手臂与半边脸发浅，远侧半张脸进入硬影。神情克制，嘴闭合，视线朝画外左方。灰墙带微弱布料般或灰泥般肌理。一块巨大的三角黑影从头后扫向右侧与下沿，几乎与人物一样强烈地塑造构图。另一处深暗楔形从左下前景进入。裤子在右下提供较柔的中灰平面，宽褶接住低调光线。细微摄影颗粒可见，明暗从近白皮肤亮点经有纹理的灰色到浓厚哑黑。背景没有可辨物件或文字，只有表面与阴影。浅亮裸臂、紧凑深色上衣和严厉的斜向墙影让排列显得朴素而略带对峙感，偏心人物由阴影牢牢固定。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white photography uses a simple gray ground, one strong diagonal shadow, and an off-center compact focal mass. Hard upper-side light produces pale highlights on selected smooth planes and a sharp light-dark boundary, while broader mid-gray areas retain soft folds and fine grain. Matte black forms occupy large triangular zones that counterbalance the smaller lit center. The cropping is close but leaves enough open background for the cast shape to read clearly. Few surface details compete with the tonal geometry, so each edge, shadow wedge, and small reflective accent gains weight. The composition feels austere and direct, held by asymmetry, visible analog texture, and a restrained grayscale.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影使用简单灰底、一道强斜影和偏心的紧凑焦点大块。上方侧光在选定平滑平面上产生浅亮高光与锐利明暗界，较宽中灰区域则保有柔褶与细颗粒。哑黑形态占据大块三角区域，平衡较小的受光中心。裁切贴近，却留足够开放背景让投影形状清楚可读。很少表面细节与明暗几何争夺注意，因此每道边、影楔和小反光重点都有重量。构图朴素而直接，由不对称、可见模拟肌理和克制灰阶支撑。
theme_en: A short-haired sitter in a sleeveless dark top against a strongly shadowed wall
theme_zh: 一名短发坐者穿深色无袖上衣，身后墙面有强烈阴影
name: Collier Schorr
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
